body:
Based on https://github.com/link-assistant/legal best practices we need provide a copy of all laws we know how to download, and present for reading and referencing, so legal agent can use this copy to reference.

We also need to make sure it is legal to get copies of law and redistribute, if so, we should also do links to original sources in our copy of world's laws.

If we legally not allowed to have a copy, we can try to load data dynamically on client side from the source, which should be converted to unified format.

We should have options to have both in any case, and single algorithm for conversion which will work in CI/CD, locally, or directly in the web browser at GitHub Pages.

So for all countries we plan to support at https://github.com/link-assistant/legal we should use this repository as static web copy of laws using GitHub Pages, and we also source of all meta data, represented as links notation.

We should use associative tech stack where possible: https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/main/docs/associative-tech-stack.md

We also need to configure our CI/CD on schedule, so everything will get auto-updated from sources, when new versions of laws arrive.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Initial version of static laws browser
